limitations: Artifact review only; no worker, fault or production replay rerun. SQLite recovery occurs only in disposable copies containing captured sidecars.
Markers plus preserved source and completed parent guard support reported os._exit(73) injections. Raw child return codes are checked in code but not separately serialized as OS receipts.
No arbitrary crash-location coverage: four selected boundaries at the first notification only, three repetitions each.
Conditional single-writer, same-machine SQLite sink contract; not general exactly-once network delivery, power-loss durability, kernel-crash recovery or live reorg handling.
No independent reconstruction of perf_counter observations/quantiles: only published scope, counts and internal inequalities can be audited from persisted summaries.

Any failed recorded DB hash or malformed recovered-copy state invalidates accepting the whole run as final durable evidence until resolved; preserve original evidence, never rewrite hashes to force a pass.

measurement_review.finding: Deterministic availability/feature-ready/decision clocks have zero modeled service delay. Persistence timings are separate observations; they do not measure externally delivered alert latency.
State serialization timer includes both checkpoint and decision JSON. local_commit_seconds includes BEGIN, inserts/update and COMMIT, not only COMMIT.
Sink timer includes the whole local sink transaction; ack timer includes BEGIN/update/COMMIT. The after-sink fault permits an extra attempt while unique matching alert_id prevents another effect.

Worker-to-loop-end excludes final DB export, close, gzip and summary. RSS is sampled after materializing decision/effect/attempt lists, before export/close. Stage statistics in fault cells describe only the successful resumed worker; aborted-worker samples are not preserved.
Parent initial/restart process elapsed values include process launch, execution, exports and exit; restart measurement excludes preceding crash inspection/snapshot work.
